Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1369
Claimant:
Robert Cannon
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
May 11, 2025
Claim opened after the policyholder reported a low-speed collision in a shopping center pakring lot, with the claimant
stating she was the front passenger in the other vehicle involved. Initial contact made and the claimant's representing
attorney has asked that all communication be directed to their office.
June 28, 2025
Reviewed the first notice of loss and the photos submitted by the policyholder, which confirm the general location and
the positions of both vehicles after impact. Police report on file notes the claimant was present in the vehicle at the
scene.
July 11, 2025
Spoke with the driver, who lives with the policyholder and is listed as a household member on the policy, and
confirmed coverage applies to this operator. Driver described the impact in the same way as in the initial report.
July 24, 2025
Inpsected the damaged vehicle with the repair estimate. The damage is largely consistent with the impact described,
and no prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the owner's account.
August 18, 2025
Checked coverage history and found nothing suggesting the damage predates the policy inception, so the loss falls
within the current term.
September 12, 2025
Attorney submitted the claimant's medical records, which document a neck strain. The diagnosed injury fits the kind
and force of a collision of this type.
September 18, 2025
Reviewed the treatment timeline. Care followed a usual course, with visits tapering as the claimant's symptoms
improved. Records also mention a small strain in the same area several years ago that healed fully.
October 7, 2025
Took a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. Account matched the account given in each prior
conversation, with no changes to the sequence of events.
November 1, 2025
Asked for independent witness contact information. None was provided, and the photos are the only independent
confirmation of details beyond the police report and the parties' statements.
December 12, 2025
Evaluation is ongoing. Injury, treatment, and property damage are being assessed together, and a summary will go to
the supervisor once the remaining medical bills arrive.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
